chunks: And whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim al-Astarābādī, I have narrated it from him.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; the author’s statement of transmission
key_terms.عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ الْأَسْتَ: from Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim al-Astarābādī, indicating the named transmitter in the chain
key_terms.عَنْهُ: from him; indicating direct transmission from the named narrator

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim al-Astarābādī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the transmission route used by the author for reports attributed to Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim al-Astarābādī. It serves as a sanad notice identifying the author’s direct narration from this transmitter.
